decisions.reason: As a combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot tightly rooted in the firm's existing automation, formwork and control capabilities, it remains a strong fit for continued refinement rather than withdrawal.
The automatic de-shuttering robot still draws directly on core plant-process know-how and can be improved through customer feedback, though some portfolio overlap keeps a moderate withdrawal risk.
The profile storage robot fits the firm's established production-system knowledge, but as a more specialized module it remains somewhat more exposed if demand stays limited.

This combined magazining cleaning and plotting machine builds on the firm's integrated line expertise and multiple-model approach, so management is likely to learn across installations and retain it while optimizing the range.

Production analysis software is close to the firm's controls, service and lifecycle-support capabilities, making it strategically valuable and improvable through the firm's own R&D and installed-base learning.
